entries.mem0ai/mem0: This official Hermes Agent memory provider functions as a universal memory layer supporting multi-level states for users, sessions, and agents. It features temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval, available through a managed cloud, an Apache-2.0 self-hosted server, or an OSS SDK.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: OpenViking is an AGPL-3.0 context database that organizes information as a virtual filesystem using viking:// URIs. It utilizes a three-tier loading system (L0/L1/L2) to achieve significant token reduction and task-completion gains through background memory extraction and merging.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: This platform provides agents with persistent long-term memory by building self-hosted knowledge graphs from text and code. It supports automatic routing across graph, vector, and code retrieval to maintain context across multiple agent sessions.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: This opinionated agent brain stores explicit facts with provenance and generates synthesized answers featuring citations and knowledge gap analysis. It is distinguished by its ability to create a self-wiring knowledge graph without utilizing LLM calls.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: An official Hermes provider, this engine maintains user profiles with stable facts and automated knowledge updates while supporting sub-300ms recall. It features a custom vector graph engine with byte-level deduplication and includes connectors for platforms like Google Drive, Notion, and GitHub.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: Hindsight provides agent memory focused on long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflows. It supports over 25 LLM providers and offers flexible deployment options including Docker, Kubernetes, and managed cloud services via Python and Node.js SDKs.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: This library enables stateful agents by extracting conclusions from conversation history to provide reasoning-first memory. It is implemented as a FastAPI server and serves as the upstream library for the honcho-self-hosted Hermes wrapper.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: Operating under the Elastic License 2.0, this provider manages memory as a git-like repository with versioning for markdown context trees. It features a 5-tier retrieval system that achieves sub-100ms speeds, utilizing an interactive TUI and REPL interface.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: This zero-dependency system provides sub-millisecond AI memory for Hermes Agents using only a SQLite database and one pure-Python dependency. It features episodic compression to ensure sub-linear storage growth and supports MCP and native tool integrations.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: This seven-layer system utilizes local infrastructure like Qdrant and Redis to manage persistent memory, structured facts, and an auto-curated wiki. It employs a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure agents prioritize specific injected contexts during recall.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: This recursive harness helps agents succeed on complex tasks by iterating through executions to retain useful lessons and artifacts. It stores immutable context bundles and outcome-gated promotion data directly in the filesystem.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: A Lossless Context Management plugin for Hermes Agent, this tool uses a SQLite store and hierarchical DAG to ensure no messages are lost. It provides specialized recall tools like lcm_grep and lcm_recall for precise detail recovery.
entries.vshulcz/deja-vu: This tool indexes local history from over 20 coding agents to enable millisecond lookups across months of past session data. It prioritizes security by automatically stripping keys and tokens during the indexing process.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: This self-hosted backend provides private cross-session memory for Hermes Agent using Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis. It is compatible with any OpenAI-compatible LLM provider or local inference servers.
entries.plur-ai/plur: Plur offers a shared memory layer that stores data as plain-text YAML files for local ownership and transparency. It utilizes hybrid BM25 and embedding search to provide local-first retrieval for MCP-compatible tools.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: Signet-AI is a local-first identity and memory layer that achieves 97.6% answer accuracy on LongMemEval benchmarks. It automates memory construction from Discord, Obsidian, and office documents for use across Hermes Agent and other coding clients.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: This on-device context engine operates entirely locally without cloud dependencies or API keys. It employs hybrid retrieval, combining BM25 and vector search, to serve agents via MCP and dedicated plugins.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: Sibyl-Memory provides durable, file-based long-term memory using a five-tier hierarchical SQLite schema and FTS5 search. The architecture is unique for requiring zero vector databases and zero embedding models.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: This optimization tool reduces prefill latency by 1.5–3× and saves up to 36% of tokens through block reordering and deduplication. It provides native plugin support for the Hermes Agent and OpenClaw ecosystems to accelerate long-context inference.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This plugin features explainable retrieval by attaching a 'why_retrieved' tag to every recalled memory. It includes first-class primitives for tracking contradictions and supports an embedded in-process backend for serverless environments.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: AgentCairn uses an Obsidian vault as the source of truth, storing durable memory as inspectable Markdown files. It avoids opaque databases in favor of a local DuckDB cache for hybrid search across coding projects.
entries.JanYork/llm-wiki-cli: This CLI serves as a machine interface for agent-driven knowledge maintenance, preserving citations and temporal memory without a vector database. It supports portable archives, allowing agents to autonomously recall and merge wiki data between stores.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: Brainstack integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single memory kernel for Hermes Agent. It manages state and retrieval through SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to deliver purpose-built evidence packets for every query.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: This anticipatory memory system prefetches context by monitoring agent session logs in real-time. It utilizes SQLite-vec and GGUF models for local-first storage and provides an MCP-native server for automated configuration.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: This memory layer resolves live workspace states into verified context files to minimize token usage. It features local-first persistence and session history tracking, supporting integration via MCP-native stdio or SSE servers.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: Keep provides reflective memory through a combination of BM25 full-text search and ranked graph traversal. It automates indexing for codebases and multimedia while using edge tags to create bidirectional relationships between stored notes.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: This project reduces prompt overhead by using local BM25 ranking to select relevant tool schemas. It includes a dedicated dashboard for tracking token savings and is compatible with Hermes Agent v0.14.0 native tool search.
entries.conorbronsdon/claude-context-os: A Git-backed workflow layer that manages context updates through hash-checked proposals and receipts. It provides a source-neutral migration path for document exports and supports coding agents like Claude Code and Codex.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin utilizes an embedded .lbdb graph database to store memories with 1-10 importance rankings. It prioritizes high-value information during prefetch using BM25 keyword search and optional entity extraction.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: This episodic memory plugin features an on-demand summarizer and a trace.jsonl audit log for tracking all memory operations. It distinguishes itself by supporting immediate, permanent event deletion to prevent old data from affecting future recall.
entries.piprail/piprail: Piprail enables agents to manage financial transactions via an MCP server for budget-bound wallets. It supports USDC and stablecoins across multiple chain families, including EVM and Solana, without requiring a backend or API keys.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin indexes local artifacts such as scripts, cron jobs, and documentation for agent use. It registers five native tools for searching and reporting artifact usage, automatically generating tool routing notes using model tokens.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: XMemo provides durable cross-session memory through pre-turn context injection and session-end snapshots. It relies on a local SQLite reliability layer and a write outbox to manage searching, remembering, and updating state.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: This plugin integrates Exabase M-1 to provide self-organizing long-term memory for agents. It includes tools for manual memory storage and supports configurable query expansion and result reranking to improve retrieval accuracy.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This tool adds deterministic slash commands for searching and syncing private local code repositories. It requires a local SourceVault server for indexing and provides LLM-callable tools for grounded Q&A and file reads.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: MongrelDB offers encrypted long-term memory using AES-256-GCM at rest and supports both Rust FFI and HTTP execution modes. It combines HNSW ANN dense retrieval with sparse and exact-text recall, featuring MinHash deduplication and metadata filters.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This provider offers 17 specialized tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal using a hybrid search approach that combines BM25, vector, and graph methods. It maintains continuity during message compression through automatic context checkpointing, enabling structured information retrieval for Hermes agents.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-memory-kit: A file-based memory hygiene tool that uses a git-backed directory to store versioned markdown files without requiring a database. It features five slash commands for capture and recall, alongside 'rot' and 'lint' curators that identify stale or conflicting data to propose evidence-cited diffs.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework implements a subagent-driven development methodology to enable autonomous task execution. It enforces test-driven development and YAGNI principles while integrating as a plugin for various coding harnesses and CLIs.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first system for generating web, mobile, and motion graphic artifacts with native support for the Hermes Agent runtime. It exports designs to formats including HTML, PDF, PPTX, and MP4 through integration with the DeepSeek Harness.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This library provides 818 structured skills across 34 security domains, mapped to frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK, ATLAS, and D3FEND. The skills are compatible with over 26 AI platforms to support standardized cybersecurity operations.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This tool converts codebases, infrastructure-as-code, and schemas into draw.io diagrams using natural language descriptions. It supports incremental synchronization to preserve manual layouts and offers both a CLI and an optional MCP server.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: Serving as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, this skill provides a master router for delegated permissions and x402 payments. It includes a verification and dispute resolution layer alongside vendored protocol skills to manage autonomous transactions.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This utility audits and rewrites content to eliminate detectable AI patterns using a two-pass detection process. It offers rewrite, detect-only, and edit-in-place modes with optional voice profiles for different professional tones.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This agentic evolver automates skill deduplication and quality improvement across sessions for Hermes and other OpenAI-compatible APIs. It features a bilingual dashboard for inspecting session traces and managing the collective evolution of skills.
entries.wondelai/skills: A cross-platform library containing 51 expert frameworks and 14 guided metaskills compatible with agent-plugins.org specifications. It maintains session state within the project's documentation folder to support persistent agent workflows.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection features 1,169 skills for professional and life tasks distributed as plain markdown files under the MIT license. The skills are designed to run natively in Hermes Agent and Claude Code with ready-to-paste exports for other assistants.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This skill set enables agents to perform video searches, browse channels, and extract transcripts or playlist data. It is compatible with Hermes Agent, OpenClaw, and various AI IDEs, requiring a TranscriptAPI key for operation.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: A meta-skill plugin that monitors active workflows to automatically detect and propose reusable patterns. It generates both SKILL.md documentation and Python plugin scaffolds, managed via dedicated slash commands.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This project teaches Hermes Agent to write its own analytical prompts and custom thinking instructions for specific tasks. It utilizes pre-built analytical lenses and generates reports that highlight potential analysis blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This project provides type-safe support for remote skill registries using Git and S3 sources. It includes sandboxed execution to isolate untrusted scripts from the host while offering tools for reading bundled resources.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: This skill transforms rough concepts into structured design and implementation documents through Lite and Full complexity modes. It features a spec review gate that utilizes PASS/FAIL evaluation models to manage project handoffs.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This literate programming skill enables agents to generate .lit.md files that combine prose, diagrams, and source code. It includes a tangler for extracting runnable files and automatically syncs source edits back to the primary documentation.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: This local-first harness uses a Git-based architecture to manage long-running agents without a background service. It implements the SLP protocol for supervised team coordination across a three-layer system of kernels, plugins, and recipes.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin facilitates cross-instance shared memory via markdown files to capture high-value decisions and outcomes. It establishes a pipeline for fine-tuning and transitioning tasks to replacement models.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This community resource provides installation guides and skills in the SKILL.md format specifically for Portuguese-speaking users. It adheres to the agentskills.io standard to ensure compatibility with the broader ecosystem.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: These skills enable agent interaction with oracle networks and smart contracts, supporting CCIP, Data Feeds, and VRF integrations. The project follows the Agent Skills specification and is installable via the Vercel open skills ecosystem CLI.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: This official suite provides eight specialist skills for FLUX image and video generation, including BFL API integration for polling and webhooks. It offers specific prompting guidelines to optimize media generation workflows.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool converts repositories, documentation, and developer discourse into agentskills.io-compliant skills. It automates the workflow for briefing, testing, and exporting skills while linking instructions to specific file lines.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: This registry offers a Python client and CLI for installing reusable AI skills with recursive dependency resolution. It also incorporates commerce features by supporting payments via the TON network.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: This local-first workflow language defines AI tasks as code within YAML files using a four-verb structure. It provides a Rust-based CLI to check, run, and trace execution across various models including OpenAI and Codex.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: This skill enables autonomous execution of complex, multi-step tasks with real-time progress and decision tracking. It includes built-in rollback procedures and checkpoints to ensure safe recovery during long-running operations.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables Hermes Agent to manage files, calendars, tasks, and contacts through standard WebDAV and CalDAV protocols. It ensures secure communication via HTTPS and includes a guided setup script for credential validation.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This progressive MCP client utilizes a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token usage during agent interactions. It features a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and supports incremental discovery of server metadata and tool schemas.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: Serving as a community hub for skill discovery and one-click installation, this project implements the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification. it operates autonomously on NVIDIA infrastructure and provides federated search across GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: This project provides a five-layer retrieval system that uses hard triggers and semantic embeddings to narrow skill lists before LLM calls. By filtering relevant skills, it reduces token usage and offers graceful degradation if specific embedding models are unavailable.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: Designed as an ADHD-friendly execution system, this project uses MCP connections to facilitate agent-driven scheduling and habit tracking. It stores all data locally in a single SQLite file and includes both a React web app and an Expo-based Android application.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: This read-only tool performs adversarial code reviews by employing three parallel subagents to identify edge cases and integration issues. It combines deterministic pre-scans using tools like Semgrep and Bandit with verified findings through proof-of-concept execution in a sandbox.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin optimizes prompts across various interfaces like Discord and Telegram, achieving a 20–80% reduction in token usage. It supports 97 languages and evaluates prompt quality across five distinct dimensions.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: Inspired by Claude Code, this skill uses a trio of agents focused on hygiene, clarity, and correctness to simplify codebases. It supports multiple languages including Python and Go, utilizing a tiered application process with a mandatory approval gate.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project implements systematic investigation protocols and multi-story task decomposition with mandatory evidence-based verification gates. It includes a Python goal engine to manage persistent task states and prevent early-stop errors during causal debugging.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: This C# and .NET implementation of the agentskills.io pattern enables tool-based skill loading through Microsoft.Extensions.AI. It supports progressive disclosure via SKILL.md files and automates the registration of common agent skill directories.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: This turnkey cybersecurity lab equips Hermes Agent with over 2,000 skills and 131 tools for forensics and exploitation. It integrates 28 frameworks, including MITRE ATT&CK and OWASP, to address real-world exploits ranging from 2015 to 2026.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skills: This toolkit adds session management and worktree recovery to provide memory between agent conversations. It orchestrates parallel subagents for architectural reviews and includes specialized tools for detecting state drift and scaffolding new skills.
entries.Diabloluo/hermes-hud: This local-first dashboard provides real-time observability for Hermes Agent across 11 monitoring tabs, including token costs, session history, and error tracking. It enforces a strict read-only boundary with zero outbound telemetry to ensure data privacy during local development.
entries.conorbronsdon/demo-gif-skill: This skill automates the creation of reproducible demo GIFs for repositories by generating recording scripts via vhs or Playwright. It manages the full pipeline of rendering, compressing files to under 8 MB, and embedding the resulting markdown into README files.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skill-builder: This tool generates Claude Code and portable agent skills from plain language while ensuring they adhere to current frontmatter specifications. It includes a validator with CI-friendly exit codes that monitors official specs weekly to detect and report version drift.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This CLI and MCP server enables agents to search a database of over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 skills. It provides direct installation commands for discovered tools and integrates with MCP-compatible clients like Hermes, Cursor, and Claude Code.
entries.Carlo1911/skill-evolution: This host-agnostic framework creates a self-improvement loop by analyzing session history to identify and propose skill coverage gaps. It gates all updates behind deterministic and LLM-judge evaluators and operates locally using the Python standard library.
entries.CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills: These skills enable deterministic path routing and Python interpreter selection across Windows, Git Bash/MSYS, and WSL environments. The tool ensures environment-specific path syntax is used and verifies project-compatible runtimes without requiring new installations.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates USDC payments for HTTP 402 responses using protocols such as Pay Link, x402, and MPP. It is compatible with the agentskills.io standard and supports Hermes Agent and OpenClaw environments.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: This collection provides specialized tools for Chinese-language workflows, including Douyin video transcription to Markdown and rule-based removal of common AI writing patterns. It also features macOS-based OCR for structured data extraction and an e-commerce material studio.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: This utility certifies the quality of AI agent skills by testing their structure, functionality, and security within isolated Docker containers. It issues cryptographically verifiable certificates using Ed25519 signatures and provides a public API for verification.
entries.webmilmind1/hermes-bounty-board: This plugin allows users to earn USDC on the Base network by answering support bounties or hosting their own bounty boards via x402. It operates without accounts or API keys, requiring only a dedicated wallet key and user-defined price ceilings.
entries.scavio-ai/hermes-agent: This project provides structured web data access across 31 platforms through an MCP server exposing 191 tools. It includes five production-grade workflow skills designed for use with Hermes, Claude, Cursor, and other compatible agents.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This skill generates multi-scale Chinese news reports ranging from global events to street-level updates. It utilizes semantic memory to integrate user interests into search expansions and produces structured summaries with core conclusions and action suggestions.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides daily-updated Nix packages for Hermes and other AI coding agents, offering both open-source and unfree licensed binaries. It serves as a reliable source for developers who need consistent access to the latest agent versions and development tools within the Nix ecosystem.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: ClawPhone provides an automated installer and configuration guides for running the Antigravity CLI and OpenClaw on ARM64 Android devices via Termux. It enables hardware and UI access through Termux:API and Termux:GUI, allowing the agent to interact directly with smartphone features.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This repository features a Termux-based installer that utilizes proot-distro Ubuntu to run Hermes Agent on Android devices. It supports interactive model setup, shell command execution, and connectivity to both local Ollama instances and external providers.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This community Helm chart facilitates the deployment of Hermes Agent on Kubernetes with a focus on single-writer state safety for persistent storage. It supports both direct deployments and operator-ready workflows, including configurable gateway modes with API and webhook listeners.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: This one-command installer brings Hermes to both Android and iOS platforms using Termux and iSH. It distinguishes itself by integrating with Telegram for voice and file messaging and supporting scheduled tasks via cron jobs on mobile hardware.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: Hermesclaw provides a high-security deployment option using NVIDIA OpenShell for hardware-enforced sandboxing. It implements kernel-level restrictions on network and filesystem access, governed by configurable security policies for web searches and messaging.
entries.solomon2773/nora: Nora is a self-hosted control plane for operating Hermes agents on Docker or Kubernetes, featuring a catalog of 69 credentials and 17+ LLM provider integrations. It prioritizes security through AES-256-GCM encryption for secrets and mandatory encryption keys.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project offers a straightforward Docker sandbox image that includes the official Hermes installation and mini-swe-agent. It supports persistent state through mounted home directories and allows users to build specific agent versions using build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This NixOS module enables reproducible Hermes deployments through declarative configuration of workspace documents and settings. It supports a hybrid skill management system and integrates securely with systemd EnvironmentFiles and sops-nix for secret handling.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: HermesHQ is a Docker-first control plane designed to manage multiple agent instances with separate workspaces and RBAC-controlled access. It enables hierarchical communication and delegation between agents, alongside enterprise MCP access for external AI clients.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: Targeting Ubuntu and Debian servers, this project configures the Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service for headless operation. It is optimized for production environments requiring the autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: Hermes OTG is a portable distribution that runs from USB drives without requiring host installation or registry modifications. It bundles its own Python environment, PortableGit, and rescue tools to support Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes in offline or isolated environments.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework deploys specialized agents to conduct fundamental, sentiment, news, and technical analysis for financial trading. It utilizes structured debates between bullish and bearish researchers to assess risk and supports multiple LLM providers including OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, and DeepSeek.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: This self-hosted orchestration platform governs agent registration, task dispatching, and cost tracking across multi-agent workflows. Users can manage agents via a Web UI, CLI, or MCP server, with support for local Node.js installation or Docker deployment.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This control surface manages multiple coding agents, including Hermes Agent and Claude Code, through TUI and web dashboards. It features container-based isolation, Git worktree management, and persistent sessions via tmux for background execution.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: This execution engine is the first to manage Hermes agents on the Solana blockchain using the Claude-style MCP protocol. It detects HTTP signals to handle payment-required states for paid APIs and supports scaling from single VPS agents to orchestrated teams.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: This template uses a level-based architecture and a task bus pattern to scale Hermes Agent from a single instance to automated specialist teams. It includes bundled skills for technical operations such as VPS provisioning, security auditing, and backup management.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: This orchestration tool enables the creation of autonomous swarms with durable memory and visual org charts for team delegation. It supports over 23 LLM providers and integrates MCP tools to expand agent capabilities.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This mission control interface allows users to supervise autonomous Hermes Agent work through a Kanban board and human-in-the-loop verification. It provides live streaming of agent reasoning and tool execution to facilitate the review of task completions.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This system coordinates 17 specialized agents across a strict pipeline architecture for research, planning, and infrastructure tasks. A Master Orchestrator manages the routing and coordination of these agents to ensure structured project implementation.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This local web system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents using Hermes Agent profiles and the MCP and ACP protocols. It features a real-time UI for monitoring agent dialogues and managing task lifecycles via a Hermes Kanban board.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-optimization framework automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code for Hermes Agent. It orchestrates TBLite and TerminalBench-2 evaluations while providing structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: This arena orchestrates nine autonomous agents across two competing AI companies to battle for GitHub stars. It utilizes Paperclip and Hermes Agent for task execution and learning, visualized through a real-time scoreboard and task dashboard.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: This fully-local framework implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack using Hermes for task routing and tool-calling on consumer GPUs. It is optimized for RTX 4080/5080 hardware and runs via Ollama to eliminate cloud dependencies.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool provides a local, Rust-powered code knowledge graph that reduces token usage for Hermes Agent by pre-indexing symbols and callers. It automatically synchronizes the index on every file change and includes a browser-based UI for visualizing code relationships.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: Tokscale is a CLI utility and 3D dashboard that tracks token consumption and costs across multiple coding agents, including Hermes. It extracts data from local session logs and SQLite databases to provide comprehensive usage analytics.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer allows developers to inspect API traffic from Hermes Agent and other coding tools while redacting sensitive authentication headers. It generates self-contained HTML viewers for exported sessions, facilitating deep debugging of agent communications.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This widget provides real-time monitoring of token usage, costs, and rate limits by reading Hermes Agent state directly. It supports multi-device synchronization and tracks historical usage trends across more than 37 different AI coding tools.
entries.bergside/typeui: TypeUI offers design systems and layout guidance through MCP servers to help build better user interfaces with AI. It integrates directly with Hermes Agent and other providers that support markdown or general prompting.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: This opinionated workflow layer coordinates seven specialized agents and 36 skills to streamline building and shipping applications with Hermes Agent. It is designed for autonomous execution on both local laptops and remote VPS environments.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: Hermes-skins enables visual customization of the Hermes terminal UI through YAML-based themes. Users can modify banner colors, spinners, and ASCII art to create aesthetics ranging from retro DOS to cyberpunk.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This project ports the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills to the Claude Code Channel, allowing it to run natively without external processes or OAuth. It includes specialized MLOps tools for vLLM, GGUF inference, and reinforcement learning training.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This platform establishes a social economy for autonomous agents by providing encrypted messaging via the Signal Protocol and human-readable identity handles. It enables Hermes Agent to participate in commerce using Solana-based USDC and SOL payments.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: Vessel is an AI-native browser designed for autonomous agent control through a supervisor sidebar that manages approvals and checkpoints. It supports external MCP clients and browser automation workflows for providers like Anthropic and OpenAI.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: This project provides memory integrations for various frameworks using a two-tier system of knowledge graphs and session caches. It extends memory capabilities to chat platforms like Slack and Telegram as well as development environments like VS Code.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve up to 99% token savings during Hermes Agent workflows. it comes with over 40 pre-configured skills for DevOps, finance, and research, featuring automated installation for macOS and Linux.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: This framework enables the creation of scoped Hermes Agents using per-folder configurations and local skills. It allows for seamless switching between default and scoped agents while supporting project-local memories, tools, and custom instructions.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This tool provides automated installation for the hermes-agent stack and 12 supporting services across three scalable deployment tiers. It facilitates a zero-cost setup with support for 29 community plugins categorized into six functional areas.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: A static linter for AI agent configurations that performs local, zero-LLM analysis to flag overlapping tool descriptions and inconsistent schemas. It supports Python 3.10+ and integrates with CI workflows through SARIF output.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration utility transitions OpenClaw assets, including SOUL.md and memory archives, into Hermes-compatible YAML and JSON formats. It also configures systemd gateway services and handles nested authentication structures during the migration process.
entries.observeco/observeco: This self-healing observability tool uses a native Hermes plugin to export real-time telemetry without cloud dependencies. It monitors multi-agent systems through passive analysis and active probing to detect performance drift relative to local file changes.
entries.33hodl/hermes-startup: Designed for generating revenue via Hermes Agent, this tool operates as a deterministic zero-network local runtime by default. It enforces safety by requiring explicit approval for all external writes and consequential actions through specific contract structures.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: This local voice assistant adds open-mic and wake-word capabilities to Hermes Agent without requiring API keys or accounts. it supports adaptive turn-taking and barge-in across 35 languages using Piper and 9 languages via Kokoro.
entries.181079342/hermes-memoss: This memory plugin for Hermes provides tools for searching, adding, and deleting memories using multi-dimensional storage and semantic search. It includes a built-in circuit breaker to maintain stability during MemOS API outages.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: This cross-platform manager, built on the Tauri 2 framework, supports Windows, macOS, and Linux. It serves as an all-in-one tool for managing configurations for Hermes Agent alongside other CLI tools like Claude Code and Gemini CLI.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: AionUi is a local cowork application featuring a built-in agent engine with full file read and write access. It enables 24/7 automation via Cron and provides remote access through a WebUI and various messaging platforms.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: Developed with Python and vanilla JavaScript, this interface allows users to access Hermes Agent from web browsers or mobile devices. It features a circular context ring for monitoring token usage and supports secure access through SSH tunnels.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: This desktop companion app facilitates the installation, configuration, and operation of Hermes Agent across multiple AI providers. It provides a dedicated GUI for managing chat sessions, tools, and guided provider setup.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio: This web dashboard manages AI chat sessions across ten communication platforms, including Telegram, Discord, and Slack. It supports visual workflows with approval gates, scheduled jobs, and detailed usage analytics.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: This native web workspace features a Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers. It integrates a Monaco-based file browser, a PTY terminal, and specialized panels for memory browsing and MCP catalog management.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: Codeg is a collaborative workspace that aggregates sessions from Hermes and other agents into desktop, standalone server, or Docker deployments. It includes fifteen built-in agents and offers native iOS and Android clients for remote connectivity.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: Designed as a native Mac workspace, this tool provides direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts with an embedded terminal for shell access. It includes native views for managing sessions, Kanban boards, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: Built with Tauri, TypeScript, and Rust, this Windows-first application features a built-in Hermes-CN-Core kernel with health check capabilities. The UI supports LaTeX and Markdown rendering for chat, memory management, and process control.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium side-panel extension connects browser context to Hermes runtimes via local gateways or remote APIs. It offers site-aware drafting assistance and live browser control with approval gates and tab triage features.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: Hermex is a native SwiftUI iPhone app for iOS 18+ that pairs with a hermes-webui server without using third-party relays. It allows users to manage agent chat, server files, skills, and scheduled tasks directly from a mobile device.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: This desktop workspace provides one-click setup for Hermes Agent and other engines while offering custom LLM model routing. It includes a runtime dashboard for tracking token usage and latency alongside a live workspace for monitoring code writes.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-hud: This interactive TUI consciousness monitor features nine tabs and four color themes for tracking agent growth and git projects. It provides a tmux operator view specifically designed for managing live agent panes and scheduled cron jobs.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: This self-hosted web dashboard offers a browser-based terminal and a ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking agent health and kanban pipelines. It includes an MCP server control plane for managing server lifecycles alongside real-time chat and tool call visualization.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS session browser that tracks live Codex and Claude quota burn and API-equivalent costs across 15 agents. It maintains local search indexing for prompts and tool calls without uploading session history or telemetry.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: This native macOS workspace provides a dedicated interface for Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts with one-click automated agent installation. It features an integrated WebRTC voice mode utilizing OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: Built with Next.js 16 and Tailwind CSS v4, this dashboard template uses a Postgres message bus to bridge local agents with a web interface. It includes a specialized approval inbox for managing agent requests that have side effects.
entries.liftaris/herm: Built with OpenTUI, this alternative interface provides a terminal-based environment for chatting and managing agent sessions. It incorporates a kanban board for task management and supports the configuration of profiles, skills, and toolsets.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: This React-based Telegram Mini App provides a 10-page mobile-first UI with terminal chat and file attachment support. It utilizes dual HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 authentication to manage up to five concurrent background agent instances.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: This portable Windows desktop application runs without installation or admin rights using embedded Python and Node.js runtimes. It features a Tkinter GUI with granular permission controls and 100 tools for TTS, music, and ComfyUI automation.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: This glassmorphic web interface provides real-time log streaming and a task tracking dashboard for self-hosted assistants. It includes management tools for skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers alongside an integrated file browser.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: A monitoring dashboard focused on session activity, cost tracking, and the inspection of skill source code. It provides read-only access to configuration and environment variables for secure process oversight.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: This chat-first workspace uses real-time SSE streaming and tool approval cards to manage agent interactions. It features an integrated marketplace for skills and MCP servers, plus isolated profile management for separate memory and API keys.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: This desktop client facilitates orchestrated collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents through a central PM orchestrator. It includes a Visual Skill Store with over 50 one-click installations and supports native streaming responses with model switching.
